about_short_description.short_description: Greenboard helps furniture stores increase close ratio through technology & Empower sales associates to follow up with clients.

product.name: Integrated Email for Furniture CRM
product.description: A CRM feature that allows furniture stores to send, receive, and manage emails within the CRM system to streamline communication and track customer interactions.

product.name: SMS within Greenboard
product.description: A feature that enables sending and receiving text messages within the Greenboard CRM platform to facilitate direct communication with customers.

product.name: Analytics
product.description: A tool within Greenboard that measures sales metrics such as close ratio, profitability, and sales associate activity to provide insights into business performance.

product.name: Bulk Email
product.description: A functionality that allows sending emails to multiple clients simultaneously from within the Greenboard CRM system.

product.name: Sequences
product.description: A feature to create multi-step email sequences sent on a user-defined schedule to nurture leads and maintain customer engagement.

product.name: Lead Sources Tracking
product.description: A CRM feature that tracks and identifies the origin of leads to help furniture stores understand where their clients are coming from.
